boards.school_name: New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe destinations in Socorro and at New Mexico Tech with late availability.

cards.title: Tu Taco Pickup
cards.subtitle: Fidel Student Services Center, New Mexico Tech
cards.notes: Use the Fidel Center pickup window when an afternoon-to-evening meal fits your schedule. Confirm holiday and academic-break changes before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus pickup option with the latest listed food-service window.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech lists Tu Taco pickup from 2:00–11:00 p.m. on weekdays and 2:00–9:00 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Listed pickup hours: weekdays 2:00–11:00 p.m.; weekends 2:00–9:00 p.m. Hours are subject to change during holidays, between semesters, and summer.

cards.title: Fire & Ice Coffee Shop
cards.subtitle: Fidel Student Services Center, New Mexico Tech
cards.notes: Stop at the ground-floor coffee shop for a drink, pastry, snack, or grab-and-go item. Check the current term schedule if campus is on break.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee and snack counter open into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech lists Fire & Ice Coffee Shop hours through 11:00 p.m. on weekdays and 7:00 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: weekdays 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; weekends 8:30 a.m.–7:00 p.m. Hours are subject to change during holidays, between semesters, and summer.

cards.title: Fidel Center
cards.subtitle: 801 Leroy Place, New Mexico Tech
cards.notes: Use the student union’s open areas, dining room, computer lab, or Quiet Lounge for an evening change of scene; follow posted building rules.
cards.short_summary: The campus student union remains open later than most campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech lists Fidel Center general hours until 11:00 p.m. on weekdays and 9:00 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Listed general hours: weekdays 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; weekends 8:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. Hours are subject to change during holidays, between semesters, and summer.

cards.title: Fidel Center Game Room
cards.subtitle: Fidel Student Services Center, New Mexico Tech
cards.notes: Plan an evening game-room visit inside the student union, leaving enough time before the listed closing time. Verify term-specific access on arrival.
cards.short_summary: A named campus recreation room with evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech lists the Fidel Center Game Room open until 10:00 p.m. on weekdays and 6:00 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: weekdays noon–10:00 p.m.; weekends 1:00–6:00 p.m. Fidel notes that hours may change during holidays, between semesters, and summer.

cards.title: Los Mario’s Mexican Food
cards.subtitle: 1001 N California St, Socorro
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own ordering site to check the menu or place an order before going. Its posted daily schedule provides a late evening option.
cards.short_summary: A Socorro Mexican-food restaurant posting service through 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Mario's official site lists its Socorro location open 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Posted business hours are 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Walmart Supercenter #5492
cards.subtitle: 700 6th St N, Socorro
cards.notes: Pick up groceries or everyday supplies while the main store is open; check individual department hours separately because they may close earlier.
cards.short_summary: A general-goods and grocery stop with an 11 p.m. store close.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart lists its Socorro Supercenter at 700 6th St N as open 6:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists main-store hours of 6:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Monday through Sunday; department hours differ.

cards.title: Burger King on North California
cards.subtitle: 1020 N California St, Socorro
cards.notes: Use Burger King’s location page to confirm the day’s service and ordering options before making the short drive north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A chain restaurant with documented late evening service in Socorro.
cards.evidence_claim: Burger King’s Socorro location page identifies the restaurant at 1020 N California St and lists evening closing times, including 11:00 p.m. on several days and midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page is the source for current service details; independently surfaced current listings show closing at 11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday. Recheck before travel.

cards.title: SONIC Drive-In on California Street
cards.subtitle: 1103 California St, Socorro
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s location page before leaving, especially for late drive-in or drive-thru service. Keep the visit focused on food and nonalcoholic drinks.
cards.short_summary: A nearby drive-in with late-night hours listed for its Socorro location.
cards.evidence_claim: SONIC’s Socorro location at 1103 California Street lists service through 11:00 p.m. most days and midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Current location information lists service until 11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday; verify the day’s hours before going.

cards.title: Arby’s on South Highway 85
cards.subtitle: 1010 S Hwy 85, Socorro
cards.notes: Check the official restaurant page for today’s availability before heading south of campus. Plan around its late-evening closing time rather than assuming all-day service.
cards.short_summary: A Socorro quick-service restaurant open into late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Arby’s official Socorro location page is for the restaurant at 1010 S Hwy 85; current location information lists closing at 10:00 p.m. most days and 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Current location information lists closing at 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday; verify hours directly before travel.

cards.title: McDonald’s on North California
cards.subtitle: 1102 N California St, Socorro
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant directory to open the location’s details and confirm current counter, drive-thru, or pickup availability before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A nearby national-chain food stop represented in McDonald’s official Socorro directory.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official Socorro directory identifies a restaurant at 1102 N California St; current location details should be checked before a late visit.
cards.access_notes: The official directory confirms the location but does not provide a stable late-hours listing in the accessible page view; verify current hours in the official location details before travel.

warnings: The official McDonald’s directory confirms the Socorro location but did not expose a stable late-hours value in the accessible page view; its card is included only as a verify-before-travel option.

boards.school_name: New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces with documented ways students can study, meet, play, or attend activities.

cards.title: Joseph R. Skeen Library
cards.subtitle: Northeast campus · study rooms and group areas
cards.notes: Reserve a study room for a small-group session, or use the library’s group-study areas and computer lab for a longer work block.
cards.short_summary: A three-story library with reservable study rooms, group areas, and student computers.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT says Skeen Library provides study rooms, flexible technology-equipped group-study areas, and a computer lab.
cards.access_notes: Room reservations have terms and scheduling limits; check the library reservation system before planning a group session.

cards.title: Office for Student Learning
cards.subtitle: First floor of Skeen Library · tutoring and reviews
cards.notes: Drop in for in-person tutoring or join a scheduled study review session; check the course-support schedule before you go.
cards.short_summary: A library-based academic-support space offering tutoring and review sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT’s Office for Student Learning offers drop-in in-person tutoring and organizes study review sessions on Skeen Library’s first floor.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring and supported-course schedules vary by term; confirm current availability with the Office for Student Learning.

cards.title: Library 208
cards.subtitle: Skeen Library · ITC computer lab
cards.notes: Use the lab’s student computers for coursework that needs campus software, and check with the library if you need the room for a class.
cards.short_summary: An ITC computer lab inside Skeen Library with student-use workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT’s library FAQ identifies Library 208 as an ITC computer lab with one instructor PC and 18 student-use computers.
cards.access_notes: Library 208 may be reserved by NMT faculty and staff for special classes; check availability before relying on it.

cards.title: Fidel 130 Open Lab
cards.subtitle: Fidel Student Center · open computer lab
cards.notes: Register an RFID-enabled Tech ID with the Help Desk, then use this open lab for computer work whenever campus access fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: One of two ITC open labs designated for current students.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT identifies Fidel 130 as an open lab that any current student may access at any time after registering an eligible ID card.
cards.access_notes: Current-student access requires an RFID-enabled ID card registered through the Help Desk in Gold 101.

cards.title: Gold 145 Open Lab
cards.subtitle: Gold Building · open computer lab
cards.notes: Set up your Tech ID through the Help Desk in Gold 101, then use the open lab for an individual assignment or shared computer task.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible ITC open lab in the Gold Building.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT lists Gold 145 as one of two open labs accessible to any current student at any time after eligible-ID registration.
cards.access_notes: Current-student access requires an RFID-enabled ID card registered through the Help Desk in Gold 101.

cards.entity_name: Joseph A. Fidel Student Services Center
cards.title: Fidel Student Center
cards.subtitle: Student union · atrium, lounge, dining, and reservable areas
cards.notes: Meet in the Atrium or Quiet Lounge, then use the reservation process if your group needs a designated event or meeting area.
cards.short_summary: NMT’s student union, combining student services with open and reservable gathering areas.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT describes Fidel as its student union, with an atrium, Quiet Lounge, dining room, open areas, terrace, ballroom, and computer lab.
cards.access_notes: NMT lists general Fidel hours as 7 a.m.–11 p.m. weekdays and 8 a.m.–9 p.m. weekends, subject to change during breaks and holidays.

cards.title: NMT Game Room
cards.subtitle: Fidel Center first floor · games and tournaments
cards.notes: Bring your Tech ID for board games, consoles, table tennis, or billiards, and check Tech Connect for the current tournament list.
cards.short_summary: A Fidel Center recreation room with tabletop, cue-sport, and video-game options.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT says its Game Room has board games, video games, ping pong, billiards, and student tournaments.
cards.access_notes: Located on Fidel Center’s first floor west of the Atrium; NMT lists regular-semester hours of noon–10 p.m. weekdays and 1–6 p.m. weekends.

cards.title: Student Activity Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Drive · sanctioned student events and meetings
cards.notes: Coordinate through a registered student organization to hold a sanctioned meeting, club activity, dance, movie night, or large gathering.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue used for sanctioned student events and organization activities.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT states that the Student Activity Center may be used for sanctioned student events and that registered student organizations may use it free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Use is limited to sanctioned student events and requires compliance with NMT and SAC policies.

cards.title: Macey Center
cards.subtitle: Olive Lane · theater, gallery, and campus events
cards.notes: Check the performing-arts calendar for an upcoming show, or visit the gallery when an exhibition is open to see campus and community work.
cards.short_summary: A 615-seat campus theater and conference center with an art gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT describes Macey Center as a 615-seat theater and conference center with an art gallery that hosts performances and special events.
cards.access_notes: Event access and admission vary; consult the Macey Center or Performing Arts Series schedule before attending.

cards.title: New Mexico Mineral Museum
cards.subtitle: Headen Building · New Mexico Tech campus
cards.notes: Plan a daytime visit to examine the mineral displays, then use the museum’s posted schedule to confirm open hours and holiday closures.
cards.short_summary: A campus mineral museum operated by the New Mexico Bureau of Geology and Mineral Resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Mexico Bureau of Geology and Mineral Resources identifies the New Mexico Mineral Museum as located on the New Mexico Tech campus and posts its operating hours.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10 a.m.–3 p.m. Saturday; it is closed Sunday and most university holidays.

cards.access_notes: The City listing marked tickets free for its 2026 event; confirm future annual-event details before attending.

cards.title: Attend a Presidential Chamber Music Series concert

boards.school_name: New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology
boards.title: Your First Weekend at New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence that starts with campus connection, includes practical shared spaces, and leaves room to explore central Socorro.

cards.title: Start with the Kelly Mine Experience
cards.subtitle: Arrival and campus connection
cards.notes: Use the required new-student program to check in, meet classmates, and orient yourself before planning independent stops around campus.
cards.short_summary: A structured start for arriving students.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech describes the Kelly Mine Experience as a required, no-additional-cost jumpstart where incoming students move in, engage in campus life, and connect with resources.
cards.source_title: Kelly Mine Experience | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: For incoming students; follow the published program schedule and check-in instructions.

cards.entity_name: Joseph A. Fidel Student Services Center
cards.title: Get your bearings at Fidel
cards.subtitle: First campus hub stop
cards.notes: Walk through the student union to locate dining, student services, the game room, and gathering areas you may use during the term.
cards.short_summary: One building connects several everyday services.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech identifies the Joseph A. Fidel Student Services Center as its student union and lists dining, student-support offices, a game room, an atrium, and open areas.
cards.source_title: Fidel Student Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: General weekend building hours listed by NMT are 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; hours can change during holidays and between semesters.

cards.title: Play a round in the NMT Game Room
cards.subtitle: A casual Fidel Center break
cards.notes: Bring your student ID and choose a low-pressure game of ping pong, billiards, board games, or video games with new acquaintances.
cards.short_summary: A free student-ID activity inside Fidel.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT says its Game Room offers board games, video games, ping pong, and billiards, and that New Mexico Tech students play free with student ID.
cards.source_title: Fidel Student Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: Listed weekend hours are 1–6 p.m.; confirm on arrival because NMT notes that Fidel hours may change.

cards.title: Set up a study base at Skeen Library
cards.subtitle: Clock tower and group-study spaces
cards.notes: Find a comfortable floor, identify the computer lab and study rooms, and save the library site for research help during your first courses.
cards.short_summary: A practical academic anchor with flexible spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT’s catalog describes the three-story Joseph R. Skeen Library as providing study rooms, group-study areas, a computer lab, and a free coffee bar.
cards.source_title: Joseph R. Skeen Library | New Mexico Tech Catalog
cards.access_notes: Library services and room reservations may have their own availability; check the library website before relying on a particular room.

cards.title: See the Mineral Museum displays
cards.subtitle: Headen Center, NMT campus
cards.notes: Make a daytime visit to the Headen Center galleries and use the displays as a concrete introduction to New Mexico’s geology and mining history.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum focused on minerals and geology.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Mexico Mineral Museum is on the NMT campus in the Headen Center and displays geological, mineralogical, and paleontological materials.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10 a.m.–3 p.m. Saturday; it is closed Sunday and most university holidays.

cards.title: Tour the Rec and Well-Being Center
cards.subtitle: Gym, fitness room, courts, and pool options
cards.notes: Take a daytime walk-through to find the gymnasiums, fitness room, courts, athletic field, and equipment checkout before deciding what to try later.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation hub with varied facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT says its Recreation and Well-Being Center includes multipurpose gymnasiums, a weight and fitness room, bouldering wall, racquetball and squash courts, field, turf court, and sand volleyball pit.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: A valid NMT ID or member swipe card is required for entry. Listed weekend hours are Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.

cards.title: Plan a bouldering-wall session
cards.subtitle: Rec and Well-Being Center
cards.notes: If climbing interests you, ask the recreation staff about the required safety course and schedule it before using the training bouldering wall.
cards.short_summary: A supervised skill-based recreation option.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT lists a training bouldering wall at its Recreation and Well-Being Center and requires a safety course for bouldering-wall use.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: NMT lists a $5 student safety course; follow staff instructions and facility-access requirements before climbing.

cards.title: Check what is on at Macey Center
cards.subtitle: Campus theater and gallery
cards.notes: Walk by the theater and gallery, then review the official calendar for a performance or public event that fits your first-weekend schedule.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for performances and events.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT describes Macey Center as a 615-seat theater and conference center on campus with an art gallery and performances among its uses.
cards.source_title: Macey Conference Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: Entry and ticketing depend on the particular event; consult the official event listing before attending.

cards.title: Locate the Etscorn Campus Observatory
cards.subtitle: Campus astronomy landmark
cards.notes: Find the observatory in daylight, then watch official astronomy-club or outreach information for an appropriate observing opportunity.
cards.short_summary: A campus observatory connected with student astronomy.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech’s Etscorn Campus Observatory is home to the NMT Astronomy Club and is used for education, outreach, teaching, and research.
cards.source_title: Etscorn Campus Observatory | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: Do not assume public drop-in access; use official club or outreach information to identify any open observing opportunity.

cards.title: Close with a Historic Plaza walk
cards.subtitle: Downtown Socorro
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk around the plaza, use the historic-walking-tour material, and note nearby landmarks for a future unhurried visit.
cards.short_summary: A downtown history walk beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Socorro identifies the Historic Plaza as the center of the city’s historic walking tour, which covers three historic districts.
cards.source_title: Historic Plaza: Kittrel Park | Visit Socorro New Mexico
cards.access_notes: Plan this as an outdoor daytime walk and check local conditions before heading out.
